title: In one experiment, a phone break was less restorative
body: In a 2019 study, people paused an anagram task to select items for a shopping list. Those who did the break task on a phone took longer and solved fewer anagrams afterwards than people who used paper or a larger screen.
takeaway: The activity during a break can matter even if the time away from work is the same.
source: Kang and Kurtzberg, Journal of Behavioral Addictions (2019)

title: Brief attention breaks helped in one test but not another
body: A 2011 experiment found that rarely switching away from a long visual task helped people maintain performance. A 2012 study failed to find the same benefit in a different vigilance task.
takeaway: Judge a break by whether it helps you return to the work, since the effect can depend on the task.
source: Ariga and Lleras, Cognition (2011); Helton et al., Experimental Brain Research (2012)
visual: a shaded desk with a paused task and an empty chair
